author: piratewithgun
body:
On a lot of maps I have recently noticed that the border of the map has been reduced significantly, meaning you can't place blocks after a certain limit. Its hard to explain here but it basically stops you from building really high, low, or making a massive bridge to the side of the map and all the way to the other teams monument.

Although this is beneficial on many maps, I think that it is too small. Often you can't even build 2 or 3 blocks behind the monument or to the side of an island.

Please make it slightly bigger again. It will still stop people making massive bridges around the edge of the map but at the moment it is impractically small, and unnecessary.

(By the way I have no objection to the height limit although I know a lot of people don't like it because it stops extreme sky-bridging.)

Thanks
